input: ⲛⲑⲟ ⲧⲉ ⲧϣⲉⲣⲓ: ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲡⲓⲑⲙⲏⲓⲛⲟⲩϯ: ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲁⲥϥⲓⲣⲓ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ: ϧⲉⲛ ⲑⲛⲟⲩⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲓⲉⲥⲥⲉ.
greedy: Thou art the daughter of the righteous God, who has cried to the Lord, out of the lowest deep.
beam: Thou art the daughter of the righteous God, who has cried out in the root of Jesse.

input: ⲭⲉⲣⲉ ⲛⲉ ⲙⲁⲣⲓⲁ: ⲑⲃ ⲣⲱⲙⲡⲓ ⲉⲑⲛⲉⲥⲱⲥ: ⲑⲏⲉⲧⲁⲥⲙⲓⲥⲓ ⲛⲁⲛ: ⲙ̀ⲫϯ ⲡⲓⲗⲟⲅⲟⲥ.
greedy: Hail to you Mary, the twelve beautiful years, that was born for us, the Mother of God the Word.
beam: Hail to you Mary, the twelve good years, she who gave birth to us, the Word of God.
